title: When setting feature profile using EditorInterface.set_current_feature_profile. Error occurs in the output window
body:
### Tested versions

Tested in Godot 4.5.stable

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.12033.1030) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K (24 threads) - 127.7 GiB memory

### Issue description

When setting feature profile using EditorInterface.set_current_feature_profile. Error occurs in the output window

```gdscript
var editor_interface: EditorInterface = get_editor_interface()
editor_interface.set_current_feature_profile("")
````

Error that occurs: 

```bash
ERROR: Cannot set enabled unknown dock 'FileSystem'.
   at: (editor/docks/editor_dock_manager.cpp:806)
   GDScript backtrace (most recent call first):
       [0] _set_current_profile (res://addons/anomalyAcesClassNameHider/anomaly_aces_className_hider.gd:187)
       [1] _enable_profile (res://addons/anomalyAcesClassNameHider/anomaly_aces_className_hider.gd:172)
       [2] _process_settings (res://addons/anomalyAcesClassNameHider/anomaly_aces_className_hider.gd:99)
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Get the editor interface instance
2. try to set the feature profile by using the code above

N/A
